sentences.en: We'll be arriving at Branley Castle in about five minutes, but before we get there I'll give you a little information about the castle and what our visit will include.
sentences.zh: 我们大约五分钟后将抵达布兰利城堡，但在到达之前，我先为大家简要介绍一下这座城堡以及本次参观的安排。

sentences.en: WAV EN So in fact there's been a castle on this site for over eleven hundred years.
sentences.zh: WAV EN 实际上，这座遗址上建有城堡的历史已超过一千一百年。

sentences.en: The first building was a fort constructed in 914 AD for defence against Danish invaders by King Alfred the Great's daughter, who ruled England at the time.
sentences.zh: 第一座建筑是一座建于公元914年的堡垒，由当时统治英格兰的阿尔弗雷德大帝之女为抵御丹麦入侵者而修建。

sentences.en: In the following century, after the Normans conquered England, the land was given to a nobleman called Richard de Vere, and he built a castle there that stayed in the de Vere family for over four hundred years.
sentences.zh: 接下来的一个世纪中，诺曼人征服英格兰后，这片土地被赐予了一位名叫理查德·德·维尔的贵族，他在此建造了一座城堡，此后四百多年间一直由德·维尔家族拥有。

sentences.en: However, when Queen Elizabeth I announced that she was going to visit the castle in 1576 it was beginning to look a bit run down, and it was decided that rather than repair the guest rooms, they'd make a new house for her out of wood next to the main hall.
sentences.zh: 然而，当伊丽莎白一世女王于1576年宣布将造访该城堡时，城堡已略显破败；人们决定不修缮原有的客房，而是在主厅旁用木材为女王新建一座宅邸。

sentences.en: She stayed there for four nights and apparently it was very luxurious, but unfortunately it was destroyed a few years later by fire.
sentences.zh: 女王在那里住了四晚，据说极为奢华，但不幸的是几年后该建筑毁于一场火灾。

sentences.en: In the seventeenth century the castle belonged to the wealthy Fenys family, who enlarged it and made t more comfortable.
sentences.zh: 十七世纪时，城堡归富有的费尼家族所有，他们扩建了城堡并使其更加舒适。

sentences.en: However, by 1982 the Fenys family could no longer afford to maintain the castle, even though they received government support, and they put it on the market.
sentences.zh: 然而，到1982年，尽管获得政府资助，费尼家族仍无力承担城堡的维护费用，遂将其挂牌出售。

sentences.en: It was eventually taken over by a company who owned a number of amusement.
sentences.zh: 最终，一家拥有多个游乐园的公司接手了该城堡。

sentences.en: parks, but when we get there I think you'll see that they've managed to retain the original atmosphere of the castle.
sentences.zh: 不过，当我们抵达时，大家会发现该公司成功保留了城堡原有的氛围。

sentences.en: When you go inside, you'll find that in the state rooms there are life-like moving wax models.
sentences.zh: 进入城堡内部后，您会在国家厅内看到栩栩如生、可活动的蜡像。

sentences.en: dressed in costumes of different periods in the past, which even carry on conversations together.
sentences.zh: 这些蜡像身着不同时期的历史服饰，甚至彼此进行对话。

sentences.en: As well as that, in every room there are booklets giving information about what the room was used for and the history of the objects and furniture it contains.
sentences.zh: 此外，每个房间都配有小册子，介绍该房间的用途以及其中陈设的物品与家具的历史。

sentences.en: The castle park's quite extensive.
sentences.zh: 城堡公园面积相当广阔。

sentences.en: At one time sheep were kept there, and in the nineteenth century the owners had a little zoo with animals like rabbits and even a baby elephant.
sentences.zh: 过去这里曾饲养绵羊；十九世纪时，城堡主人还建有一座小型动物园，饲养兔子甚至一头小象等动物。

sentences.en: Nowadays the old zoo buildings are used for public displays of paintings and sculpture.
sentences.zh: 如今，旧动物园的建筑被用于公开展出绘画与雕塑作品。

sentences.en: The park also has some beautiful trees, though the oldest of all, which dated back 800 years, was sadly blown down in 1987.
sentences.zh: 公园内还种植着一些美丽的树木，不过其中最古老的一棵已有八百年树龄，可惜于1987年被大风刮倒。

sentences.en: Audioscripts Now, you're free to wander around on your own until 4.30, but then at the end of our visit we'll all meet together at the bottom of the Great Staircase.
sentences.zh: 听力原文：现在，各位可自由参观至下午4:30，之后我们将全体在大阶梯底部集合。

sentences.en: We'll then go on to the long gallery, where there's a wonderful collection of photographs showing the family who owned the castle a hundred years ago having tea and cakes in the conservatory - and we'll then take you to the same place, where afternoon tea will be served to you.
sentences.zh: 随后我们将前往长廊，在那里您将欣赏到一组精彩的照片收藏——照片展示了百年前拥有这座城堡的家族成员在温室里享用茶点的情景；接着，我们也会带您前往同一地点，为您奉上下午茶。

sentences.en: Now if you can take a look at your plans you'll see Branley Castle has four towers, joined together by a high wall, with the river on two sides.
sentences.zh: 现在，请各位查看手中的游览图，您会发现布兰利城堡由四座塔楼组成，由一道高墙相连，城堡两侧临河。

sentences.en: Don't miss seeing the Great Hall.
sentences.zh: 请勿错过参观大堂。

sentences.en: That's near the river in the main tower, the biggest one, which was extended and redesigned in the eighteenth century.
sentences.zh: 大堂位于临河的主塔楼（即最大的那座塔楼）内，于十八世纪经过扩建与重新设计。

sentences.en: If you want to get a good view of the whole castle, you can walk around the walls.
sentences.zh: 若您想俯瞰整座城堡全景，可沿城墙步行一圈。

sentences.en: The starting point's quite near the main entrance - walk straight down the path until you get to the south gate, and it's just there.
sentences.zh: 起点离主入口不远——沿小径笔直前行至南门，入口就在那里。

sentences.en: Don't go on to the north gate - there's no way up from there.
sentences.zh: 请勿前往北门——那里没有通往城墙的通道。

sentences.en: There'll shortly be a show in which you can see archers displaying their skill with a bow and arrow.
sentences.zh: 稍后将有一场射箭表演，您可观赏弓箭手展示其使用弓箭的精湛技艺。

sentences.en: The quickest way to get there is to take the first left after the main entrance and follow the path past the bridge, then you'll see it in front of you at the end.
sentences.zh: 前往那里的最快路线是：从主入口处向左转，沿小径过桥前行，终点处即可见到表演场地。

sentences.en: If you like animals there's also a display of hunting birds - falcons and eagles and so on.
sentences.zh: 若您喜爱动物，还可观看猎禽展示——包括猎鹰、鹰类等。

sentences.en: If you go from the main entrance in the direction of the south gate, but turn right before you get.
sentences.zh: 若您从主入口出发朝南门方向行走，但在抵达南门前右转（而非穿过南门），

sentences.en: there instead of going through it, you'll see it on your right past the first tower.
sentences.zh: 您将在第一个塔楼之后的右侧看到该展示区。

sentences.en: At 3 pm there's a short performance of traditional dancing on the outdoor stage.
sentences.zh: 下午3点，户外舞台将上演一场简短的传统舞蹈表演。

sentences.en: That's right at the other side of the castle from the entrance, and over the bridge.
sentences.zh: 该舞台位于城堡入口正对面，需过桥抵达。

sentences.en: It's about ten minutes' walk or so.
sentences.zh: 步行约需十分钟左右。

sentences.en: WHENe And finally the shop.
sentences.zh: WHENe 最后是纪念品商店。

sentences.en: It's actually inside one of the towers, but the way in is from the outside.
sentences.zh: 它实际上位于其中一座塔楼内部，但入口设在塔楼外部。

sentences.en: Just take the first left after the main entrance, go down the path and take the first right.
sentences.zh: 请从主入口处向左转，沿小径下行，再向右转即可到达。

sentences.en: It's got some lovely gifts and souvenirs.
sentences.zh: 店内有诸多精美的礼品与纪念品。

sentences.en: Right, so we're just arriving
sentences.zh: 好了，我们马上就要到了。
